11wbxt: Original SpanishCue material; the situations and data are for teaching purposes, not real news or official exam texts.
wkysn2: Source A: usage report. After the renovation, the square went from hosting sporadic activities to hosting weekly workshops. A count carried out over four afternoons recorded more older people and families than before. Mornings and rainy days were not observed. The document concludes that use increased in the periods studied; it does not claim that all groups use the space more or that every dimension of coexistence has improved.
1ld08qj: Source B: business letter. Three businesses attribute a drop in sales to the removal of parking. They provide figures for two months, although they do not separate the effect of nearby roadworks or compare with the same period of the previous year. The letter also complains that they lost the notices for an information meeting. The administration acknowledges that their addresses were not on the updated list and offers a new meeting. The merchants reply that taking part after the decision has been made is not the same as having been listened to beforehand.
1kpdz89: Source C: technical note. After heavy rain, standing water appeared next to a ramp. The team notes that a drain may have become blocked and recommends checking it. An old photograph shows dampness in a nearby area, but it does not allow us to determine whether it is the same problem. The renovation may have altered some flows, a neighbor suggests; the technician considers that explanation possible, although she asks that it not be confused with a confirmed diagnosis.
nnhjyv: The neighborhood commission must recommend whether to keep the design, reverse it, or introduce a partial modification. Those who promoted the renovation have become more cautious in describing its results; those who opposed it recognize that the square has become a meeting place. This rapprochement does not resolve the disagreements, but it does allow a common proposal to be formulated: correct the drainage, improve commercial loading, and broaden the evaluation. The pending question is who will verify each measure and what will happen if the problems continue.
l3wa7f: Source D: evaluation proposal. A youth association recalls that the count did not include the hours when it usually uses the square. It asks to take part in the next observation and proposes recording activities, length of visits, and access barriers, without personally identifying those who pass through the place. Businesses agree to cooperate if sales data are presented in aggregate form. The commission will have to explain what questions each set of data can answer and what information would be unnecessary for that purpose.
kn48x5: The budget allows an immediate intervention on the drainage and a small modification of commercial loading. A comprehensive renovation would require temporarily suspending workshops that are already scheduled. The decision, therefore, is not only a matter of choosing a design: it also distributes costs and timing among groups. The mediation will have to make those consequences visible, propose a justified priority, and establish how those who consider that the agreement does not address their main difficulty can request a review.
